inventory.description: Pure, host-testable modules (Packages/VisualCore): Math, Simulation (SceneClock, FixedStepClock, SeededRandom, AccessibilityPreferences), Scenes (PointerTracker, ExportGeometry), ShaderSource, EffectsGraph, Diagnostics (FramePacing), Parameters, Persistence, TestSupport (+ placeholder AudioDSP). iOS modules (Packages/VisualCoreRendering): Rendering, Effects, UI, Automation (Debug/measurement) (+ placeholder Audio). Rules R1-R5 enforced by scripts/check_dependencies.py.

RenderHost owns the EGL display/context/surfaces over ANGLE's Metal backend, a CAMetalLayer RenderView, a frame scheduler and context generations. All GL work runs on the main thread (@MainActor; dispatchPrecondition in DEBUG). pause/resume, recreateContext (context loss) and destroy; scenes implement RenderScene setup/resize/render/teardown.

ResourceRegistry creates textures, buffers, render targets and programs under a ResourceBudget, pools render targets, caches programs, counts leaks and rejects stale handles after a generation change.

ShaderLibrary expands includes and defines with line maps; ResourceRegistry.program compiles/links through ANGLE and reports ShaderDiagnostic file:line; color-space policy in docs/rendering/color-space.md.
Versioned effect-graph description, validator (≤ 32 passes, memory quota) and GPU executor with 8 pass types; EffectScene wraps any scene and adds the Reduce Flashing limiter.

Pointer tracking and tap/drag/pinch/rotate recognizers, scene graph and mesh generators; fixed-step clock, seeded RNG, timelines/tweens and particle system; primitive/particle/mesh renderers and the UIKit touch adapter.

XcodeGen 2.46.0 specs (root project.yml for Showcase and app targets; harness specs), package schemes via scripts/xcodebuild_package.py, unsigned simulator builds, and scripts/release_check.py (47 steps at A03-P00, listed by --list): shared checks (docs, compliance, dependencies, public API, licenses, script tests, contracts), per-app documented-API, isolation, host and simulator app steps, per-app release steps generated from docs/apps/<slug>/release.json, and the reference regression steps.
Reference pinned at d93edd1 (ADR-0005), read-only; baseline steps via scripts/run_reference_baseline.py, read-only check scripts/check_reference_clean.py, ProjectMReference harness tests.
Apps own product composition, content and one-off rules (Apps/<Name>/); VisualCore owns reusable logic (constitution 1.2.0 Principle II 'Maximize reuse'); ProjectM stays in the harness (R1).
VisualCoreTestSupport (test targets only): ImageComparison/ImageDifference/ImageStatistics for pixel tests (A01-P01).

RenderView turns UIKit touches into PointerEvents (id, phase, position in points); PointerTracker keeps active pointers; tap/drag/pinch recognizers in VisualCoreScenes. No per-pointer velocity or rate-capped resampling yet.

inventory.area: Frame pacing, thermal state and time
inventory.description: FramePacing derives max FPS and render scale from thermal state and Low Power Mode (applied by RenderHost's FrameScheduler); SceneClock (play/pause/scrub/rate), FixedStepClock (fixed simulation steps), SeededRandom (xoshiro256**).

RenderHost.renderOffscreen + StillImageEncoder (opaque sRGB PNG) + ExportGeometry (A01-P04); release tooling shared by every app: check_privacy_manifest.py, check_app_release.py, bundle_licenses.py, AutomationView, AcknowledgementsView (A01-P06). A02-P06 reuses the release tooling unchanged and adds VisualCorePersistence.TemporaryFolder (app-owned short-lived files, emptied at launch) for capture crash recovery.

FullScreenShaderScene draws one validated fragment program over the target (A01 raymarched/noise families); FieldPass runs a fragment into a target or the framebuffer with active-uniform validation (A02). Shader sources declare `precision highp float`; ShaderBundle supplies the vc/ includes.

RenderCapabilities reports GL limits and extensions; the C GL table exposes vcglGetShaderPrecisionFormat, but no Swift API reports highp range/precision bits (gap G-PRECISION). FloatRenderSupport probes renderable float formats (A02).
Palette (sample, builtIns) and ParameterSchema in VisualCoreParameters; Tween/Timeline and SceneClock in VisualCoreSimulation; EasingCurve in VisualCoreMath.
Camera2D (pan/zoom/rotate in points, zoom clamped 0.1…100) and ViewMetrics (points↔pixels). No double-precision complex-plane viewport (gap G-VIEWPORT).
DocumentStore (versioned envelopes, atomic writes, migrations, per-file problems; A01 library) and TemporaryFolder (short-lived files emptied at launch; A02 captures).

matrix.notes: The escape-time shader is app content (A03 rule) with a CPU reference (research R1). A03-P01: the escape-time CPU reference (FractalMath, G-FRACTAL) passes the known-point fixtures; the GPU shader in Phase 02 is checked against it.

Closed in A03-P01 (G-VIEWPORT): PlaneViewport (VisualCoreMath) — Double center and units per point, square pixels at any aspect, anchored pinch (drift < 1e-12 relative over 1e-6...1e6), pan, resize, clamp 1e-15...1e3 with wasClamped; Camera2D unchanged.

Closed by G-PRECISION in A03-P02: the fragment highp/mediump range and precision bits are queried by RenderCapabilities (simulator values are context only) and PrecisionAdvisor turns mantissa bits, coordinate magnitude and pixel step into reliable / near / beyond-limit levels and a minimum pixel step. Device precision is measured in campaign II before any claim. A03-P05: the device measurement is automation-ready — the `precision` app mode records the reported precision and a zoom ladder at the screen's pixel step with a pass rule (device-campaign.md); simulator rehearsal only so far.
Palette cycling and tour interpolation (research R4).
Smooth escape-count coloring is app content (research R5).
The anchored complex-plane mapping is part of G-VIEWPORT (research R6).

A03-P03: bookmarks are a VisualCore NamedLibrary<Bookmark> (G-LIBRARY, generalized from A01's CompositionLibrary; A01 adoption is a recorded follow-up) with a PlaneFraming (G-FRAMING) and the precision mode; the bookmark schema and validation are app content (research R7).

A03-P04: the iteration cap (50…10,000, log slider, ÷2/×2) shows VisualCore's relative RenderCostEstimate against cap 200 on the same canvas — a ratio with light/moderate/heavy words, never a time (G-COST closed).

matrix.capability: Still capture and curated guided tours
matrix.notes: A03-P04: captures use VisualCore StillCapture (G-CAPTURE, generalized from A02's CaptureModel; A02 adoption is a recorded follow-up) at 4096 px, limited by the device and by precision; tours use FramingFlight and TourTimeline (G-TOUR closed) with Reduce Motion jumps.

matrix.capability: Visible precision limits with graceful clamping
matrix.notes: A03-P02: ExplorerModel clamps the viewport's units per point at PrecisionAdvisor.minimumPixelStep for the shader's reported mantissa bits, shows 'Near precision limit — details may blur' / 'Precision limit reached — zoom stops here', announces each change once and appends it to the canvas description (PrecisionClampTests, ExplorerUITests, audit). A03-P04: PrecisionSpacingTests show the advisor's smallest step within [1, 2] x the true float32 (23-bit) and float16 (10-bit) spacing over 2^-20…4 (the phase's regression fixture). A03-P05: the ladder verdict checks on each device that steps the app calls reliable draw correctly and that the app clamps before any unwarned breakdown.

gaps.test: Host tests: a double-precision complex-plane viewport maps screen points to plane points with aspect correction; an anchored pinch keeps the touched plane point fixed within 1e-12 relative; an aspect or size change keeps the center; zoom far beyond Camera2D's 100x; NaN/Inf rejected
gaps.justification: Found in A03-P00 (research R2): every 2D-plane app (A16 Simulation Lab, A22 Shader Studio) needs a precise plane viewport; Camera2D's contract (point space, zoom 0.1-100, used by A01) stays unchanged.

gaps.test: App-domain CPU reference: Mandelbrot origin interior, c = 2 exterior, known Julia samples; smooth escape value finite; NaN/Inf guarded; later the GPU escape counts equal the CPU reference on small grids within float32 limits (Phase 02)
gaps.justification: Constitution A03: the escape-time formulas are fractal-specific product content with a CPU reference; the reusable machinery they run on (FullScreenShaderScene/FieldPass, G-VIEWPORT, G-PRECISION) is VisualCore.

gaps.test: Simulator test: a RenderCapabilities fragment-precision query returns the reported highp range and precision bits (recorded as context, never device evidence); host tests: a VisualCoreMath precision advisor derives reliable / warn / clamp thresholds from mantissa bits and units per pixel; device precision is measured in campaign II before any claim
gaps.justification: Found in A03-P00 (research R3): any shader app that zooms or accumulates needs to know its float precision; the query belongs to VisualCoreRendering (GL) and the pure advisor to VisualCoreMath (R2).

gaps.test: Host tests: a relative work estimate (pixels x iterations x samples) is monotonic in each factor, labelled relative (never a time), and combines with QualityPolicy for interactive iteration reduction
gaps.justification: Found in A03-P00 (research R8): iteration- or sample-bound shaders (A22 Shader Studio, A24 Graphics Benchmark Lab) need the same pre-flight estimate. Moved to Phase 04 in A03-P03 (spec 028 Assumptions): the manual names the cost estimate as Phase 04's MVP.

gaps.test: Host tests: log-scale zoom interpolation between two viewports is monotonic and ends exactly on the target; eased with EasingCurve; Reduce Motion skips the animation
gaps.justification: Found in A03-P00 (research R9): tours between saved views need zoom interpolated in log space; a small generic helper on the G-VIEWPORT type.

gaps.test: Host tests: a size-independent framing (center + span across the shorter side) round-trips through PlaneViewport with a bit-exact center and the span within 1e-12 over 100 views x 5 sizes; portrait to landscape keeps square pixels; invalid values fall back; Codable validates
gaps.justification: Found in A03-P03: saved views and resizes of any 2D plane app (A16 Simulation Lab, A22 Shader Studio) need the shape-independent framing; PlaneViewport.resized keeps the scale, not the span.

gaps.test: Host tests: a generic named-document library on DocumentStore saves, reloads, renames, favorites, duplicates and deletes with name normalization and ordering; damaged, newer-version and invalid files are reported and kept
gaps.justification: Found in A03-P03 (owner reuse rule): A01's CompositionLibrary pattern is product-neutral and needed by A03 and later apps that save named documents; adopting it in A01 is a follow-up, not part of this gate.

gaps.test: Package tests on both runtimes: a still capture renders the host's scene offscreen at the requested size, writes one PNG into an app-owned temporary folder, replaces the previous file, fails with a message and no file when the size is too large, and removes its file
gaps.justification: Found in A03-P04 (owner reuse rule): A01, A02 and A03 all capture stills the same way; A02's CaptureModel generalized; adopting it in A02 (and A01's export) is a follow-up, not part of this gate.

gaps.test: Package tests on both runtimes: an app-registered automation mode runs against the one host, fills measurements and details, goes through the domain check and pass note, built-in names win, unknown modes list app modes, and reports without the new optional fields still decode
gaps.justification: Found in A03-P05 (owner reuse rule): every app's device campaign needs app-specific measurement modes (precision ladders, tours, benchmarks); one VisualCore mechanism and one report format instead of per-app runners.

reasons: Every capability maps to existing VisualCore API (6 available: fragment shaders, animation, palettes, pinch/pan, bookmarks, capture) or an additive gap (4 adaptation rows).

All gaps are additive: G-VIEWPORT and G-TOUR (VisualCoreMath), G-PRECISION (VisualCoreRendering query + VisualCoreMath advisor) and G-COST (VisualCoreDiagnostics) are reusable helpers owned per Principle II; the escape-time formulas stay app-local with a CPU reference by the A03 rule (G-FRACTAL). None needs a second renderer, a fork, private API or networking.

Double precision on the GPU is not assumed: 32-bit shader floats are the baseline, zoom is clamped at the measured limit and the limit is shown (A03 truthful precision); perturbation and emulated double stay later ideas.
Reference regression baseline recorded green 7/7 (T-A03-003) and the empty shell builds and passes its smoke test on both simulator runtimes (T-A03-005).
Phase 01 starts with G-VIEWPORT in VisualCoreMath and the app's GPU-free escape-time reference (G-FRACTAL).

A03-P01: Mandelbrot and Julia modes with accessible explanations and spoken descriptions run on a deterministic CPU reference preview (no GPU yet); PlaneViewport closes G-VIEWPORT in VisualCoreMath and FractalMath closes G-FRACTAL with the known-point fixtures; ProjectM regression 7/7.

A03-P02: the escape-time shader runs in VisualCore's FullScreenShaderScene behind RenderHost (EGL owned only by the host) and matches the FractalMath CPU reference on 64x64 grids (Mandelbrot 100%, Julia 99.9% boundary-only); anchored pinch/pan keeps the plane point under the fingers within 1e-9; five palettes with Reduce-Motion-aware animation; G-PRECISION closed (RenderCapabilities fragment precision + PrecisionAdvisor) with a visible, announced zoom clamp; ProjectM regression 7/7.

A03-P03: bookmarks keep mode, framing, seed, cap, radius, palette and precision mode in a VisualCore NamedLibrary and reopen exactly on any canvas shape (center bit-exact, span within 1e-12); a bookmark deeper than this device's precision opens clamped with a note; Go to coordinates; resizes keep the framing with square pixels (GPU 64x32 and 32x64 match the CPU reference 100%); G-FRAMING and G-LIBRARY closed; ProjectM regression 7/7.

A03-P04: an adjustable iteration cap with a relative render-cost line (G-COST); 4096 px captures that agree 64/64 with the CPU reference, limited by the device and by precision, shared through the system sheet (G-CAPTURE); three curated tours on log-scale flights with announced captions and Reduce Motion jumps (G-TOUR); the precision advisor checked against real float32/float16 spacing; ProjectM regression 7/7.

A03-P05: device precision and performance validation is automation-ready — VisualCore app modes (G-AUTOMODE) carry the app's `precision` ladder and `tour` modes; all five modes pass a simulator rehearsal on 27.2 and 26.5 (not device evidence); bookmarks reproduce identical pictures; the shipping Release has no automation; the D1/D2/D3 rows are pending the implementation lock.
